title: ר' אלעזר בר' שמעון

paragraphs: Rabbi Elazar son of Rabbi Shimon. (a) Maimonides says he appears only in Temurah 4:4, but also Beitzah 4:5 and Nega'im 12:3. Chullin 30, beginning of a; Bekhorot 51, beginning of b: ר״ת [reading unresolved], “Rabbi Shimon’s son, the anonymous-teaching authority” [בר״ש סתימתאה]. Rashi: many mishnayot and baraitot were his, which tannaim customarily arranged anonymously. See Yose son of Yehudah.

(b) Elazar son of Shimon bar Yochai spent thirteen years in the cave with his father. He accepted suffering in love, having been the king’s officer and fearing he killed someone innocent. Shimon reincarnated Moses; Elazar reincarnated the boy serving Micah’s image, son of Gershom son of Moses. The boy was thirteen; hence father and son studied thirteen cave years to repair him, Sefer Haggilgulim 36d. Thus “the name of the one was Eliezer,” not “the second,” hints Elazar son of Shimon repairing Gershom, B.A., 78a [ב״א; work unresolved]. Shipowners gave him much money, saved through his merit. A lion son of a lion, he ate much and was strong, Midrash Chazit, “His hands are gold cylinders.” See Eizehu Neshekh and Kohelet Rabbah, “Give a portion to seven.” He expounded, “Be soft like a reed”; see Shimon ben Eliezer.

(c) His colleague Yishmael son of Yose ben Chalafta was similarly fat. He studied with Rabbi before Shimon ben Gamliel and Yehoshua ben Korcha, surpassing Rabbi in Torah and deeds. Rabbi sought his wife, but she refused: “A vessel used for holiness,” etc. When he entered the assembly, Rabbi’s face darkened, Jerusalem Talmud, Hamatznia. His surviving son Yose was taught by Shimon son of Yose ben Lakunya [the Bavli reads Issi], his mother’s brother; see there. As wise as his fathers, their equal, he was not buried with them in the cave, not having shared their cave suffering. Elazar son of Shimon: “Thus Yehudah ben Beteira said,” Tosefta, Menachot, chapter 1.

(d) Rosh, Berakhot, end of Ein Omedin, reports that some identify him as Elazar Hakkallir, citing the Pesikta’s eulogy of Elazar son of Shimon. Shalshelet Hakkabbalah 31b likewise cites Pesikta for Elazar son of Shimon bar Yochai; Tosafot, Chagigah 13a, agrees. They applied “Of every merchant’s powder”: reciter, kerovah composer, poet, Vayikra Rabbah 30; Shir Hashirim Rabbah 3. In his days months were sanctified by sight: he composed kerovot only for a festival’s first day. See Elazar ben Arakh and Eliezer ben Yaakov.

(e) Buried on Yom Kippur’s eve. Bava Metzia 84b tells of burial with his father in the cave. For twenty-two years after his death, the account says he judged at home [the Bavli gives a range of eighteen to twenty-two years in the upper room]: a voice from the upper room declared one innocent, another liable. All those years no wild animal entered the town.

(f) Il'ai in his name; Elazar ben Perata in his name; Chanilai in his name. He spoke to Yehudah, Sotah 34a; Yehoshua ben Korcha sent to him. Yochanan in his name, Jerusalem Talmud, Bava Batra at כ״א [locator unresolved]; Babylonian Beitzah 15b, two expositions; Makkot 20; Chullin 89a; Sanhedrin 43b. Yose bar Yehudah; Abba Yose ben Yochanan of Yanoach. Simlai in his name; Rabbi in his name, Bereshit Rabbah 22; Shmuel in his name.
